versions.content: Support for persisting Security Events Type: draft Description: In some cases, security events need to be persisted such that they can later be queried by a diagnostic tester. Rationale: The occurence of security events can be a very important part of a forensical analysis of an intrusion. Use Case: The user wants to specify which security events shall be persisted in the Security Event Memory that is part of the Dem Dependencies:  Supporting Material:
